## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title is a Conventional Commit (`feat(select): …`, `fix(time): …`): it becomes the commit on `master`
- [ ] `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test` pass
- [ ] New logic has a test next to it
- [ ] Checked on iOS, Android and web, or said which I couldn't
- [ ] Docs updated for any new or changed component, prop or default (see "Docs stay in sync" in AGENTS.md)
